svg.text: Stage A: 2 servos on the breadboard, no soldering
Two 400-hole breadboards side by side, ESP32 across both. Holes a-e of one row are joined; so are f-j. The channel between e and f separates them.
Jumper wires (male-male; push one end into the servo plug):
red left board g15 (VIN row) -> right board a20 = 5 V from the PC's USB
brown right board c14 (GND row) -> right board b22
red c20 -> HEAD servo red, e20 -> NECK servo red
brown c22 -> HEAD servo brown, e22 -> NECK servo brown
orange e7 (D18) -> HEAD servo orange, e6 (D19) -> NECK servo orange
long leg (+) in d20, striped leg (-) in d22.
Row 20 a-e is now +5 V, row 22 a-e is GND.
Servo plugs are female: the jumper's male
pin goes into the matching colour socket.
Unplug USB while wiring. Start with the HEAD servo only; add NECK once HEAD works.
